content: The doc page https://alexkontorovich.github.io/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd/docs/ is fine. However, if you click any files belonging to the project, such as https://alexkontorovich.github.io/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd/docs/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd/Defs.html, it leads to the 404 page

Not sure if related, but my own project experienced similar doc deployment problem a while ago, and I had to manually clear github action cache to fix it. I filed https://github.com/leanprover/doc-gen4/issues/389 for this, and it looks like it has been fixed recently
Thank you for mentioning this on Zulip! This has been happening to CSLib as well for some time and I had no idea how to debug.
It has also been happening in algolean. It seems to happen whenever there is a stable v4.**.1 toolchain
As far as I understand, docgen-action#38 fixes this problem.
I'm still a little fuzzy on who is meant to be merging the PRs there. @Marcelo Lynch, do you know?

Yes, docgen-action#38 should fix this, and until then, deleting the Docs-… cache entries (or setting use-github-cache: false) should avoids the 404s.

Re: merging, @Kim Morrison I guess you and I are admins so we could merge it, but I would wait for a review by Anne Baanen (whom I can ping -- I was hoping to get docgen-action#40 completed, which also includes this fix, but it needs some upstream doc-gen4 changes still)
